parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key from the business management page of the primary account.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The new name of the perspective. The name can be up to 50 characters in length.

parameters.name: PerspectiveId
parameters.description: The primary key of the perspective.
